sections.title: Building alone is the slow way

items.title: Tutorials stop before your problem
items.body: Every video shows the happy path. Your workflow breaks on the step it skipped.

items.title: Nobody to ask
items.body: You get stuck on a step, nobody around you has done it, and a fix that should take an hour takes a week.

items.title: Too much noise, not enough builders
items.body: Most AI groups are people selling courses to each other. You want to be around people actually shipping.

items.title: Not ready to buy software
items.body: And you should not have to be, just to learn how it is built.

sections.title: Start free. Go deeper when the work demands it.

items.title: The free OASIS community
items.body: The OASIS community on Telegram. Bring a real broken workflow, ask the question, and map the next useful move with other builders. Stay as long as you like.

items.title: VIP mastermind
items.body: A weekly build room for builders with a budget, for when you want to build it live instead of alone.

items.title: One-on-one founder mentorship
items.body: For high-growth founders: direct time with an OASIS founder in a private Telegram chat. By application only.

items.title: No pressure to upgrade
items.body: The free community is the point, not a waiting room. The paid rooms are there when you want them, never before.
